hero_title: When it has to go right, call Erin.
hero_intro: I'm Erin McKinnon. I plan, staff, and run the events, campaigns, and brand programs that can't afford a bad night, from one packed forum to 176 events in a weekend.
hero_note: Now running statewide brand programs and nonprofit events across Tampa Bay.
manifesto_title: An event is anything that has to happen on time.
manifesto_text:
A launch. A candidate forum. A Derby party on the water. A statewide sampling program. A press release that has to land tonight. A situation going sideways that needs someone to take the wheel.

The job is always the same: decide what done looks like, build the structure to get there, and run it until it's finished.
ros_intro: Every job gets the same run of show.

run_of_show.text: The turnout, the budget, the result, and the story you want to tell when it's over.
Timeline, team, talent, vendors, and tracking, set up before the rush so nothing lives in anyone's head.
On site or across 20 states at once. Clear owners, fast calls, and someone watching every detail.
Clean recaps with real numbers and photos, ready for your boss, your board, or your client.

services.title: Events and production
services.text: Fundraisers, galas, signature community events, and civic forums. Concept, branding, sponsors, run of show, staffing, and the night itself.

services.title: Campaign operations
services.text: The infrastructure behind a campaign so the candidate can campaign: fundraising operations, volunteers, events, messaging calendars, and the website.

services.title: Brand activations and field programs
services.text: Statewide and national sampling and retail programs for spirits and consumer brands, with talent booked, every visit tracked, and live reporting for the client.

services.title: Systems and reporting
services.text: Custom Airtable builds connected to Twilio, SendGrid, Front, and MiniExtensions; simple websites your team can edit; and recap summaries people actually read.

bio_text:
I started in ballet and the performing arts, studied at NYU and UCF, and worked in modeling and pageants before building a career in experiential marketing. All of it taught the same lesson: show up prepared, read the room, and deliver when the lights come on.

Today I lead National Talent & Field Operations at Michele & Group (talent booking, program setup, and activation logistics), plan events and build systems for the 13 Ugly Men Foundation, and serve on the Tampa Heights Civic Association board.
cta_text: Tell me what you're running and when it has to happen. I'll tell you how I'd handle it.
